summary: Pigeon Hill, Rockport MA: municipal 40-ft wooden tower first operated 1929 and used until 1941; FFLOS-registered 2008; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed among former lookout sites and used until 1941; the register does not say whether the tower still stands, and no source describes the site today

events.note: First operated in 1929 per FFLOS; no build date is given
Used by the municipality until 1941; the register gives no reason for the end of use
Date Registered September 3, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

evidence.supports: 40-foot wooden tower, first operated 1929, used by the municipality until 1941
evidence.quote: The 40' wooden tower was first operated in 1929 and was used by the municipality until 1941.

evidence.supports: other Rockport entry on Pool Hill, first operated 1931 and used until 1941
evidence.quote: This 40' wooden tower was first operated in 1931 and was used until 1941.

corrections.why: FFLOS describes the site as a 40' wooden tower

notes_for_editor: One register entry; no staffing, fire, access or present-day sources found. Status is 'unknown', not 'gone': the register lists the site among former lookouts and gives 1941 as the end of use, but does not say the tower was removed. The 1941 end is coded 'other', not 'abandoned', because the register gives no reason. Pool Hill (site #1) is cited only for its 1931-1941 dates to set the two Rockport towers side by side. Brief kind 'unknown' corrected to tower. 40 ft converted to 12.2 m. Story says 'first operated' because no build date is given. Facebook posts from the Forest Fire Lookout Association Massachusetts chapter would not open, so they are not cited.
